Great to visit Adam Smith’s home in Edinburgh.  Proud of the work being done by FIU’s Adam Smith Center for Economic Freedom.

Smith spent years on his works and no doubt suffered through his share of brutal winters in Scotland.

Probably didn’t quite envision his namesake on a university civic institute in a city across the Atlantic that features palm trees, sandy beaches, warm weather and high rise condos.

Floridians should not be taxed out of their homes!

posts.text:
Play well, play fast.
Play poorly, play faster.
Play the fastest, win the Open!

Ryan Fox just proved there is no excuse for playing at a snail’s pace.  Bravo!

I remember renting a car in the UK years ago.  It was a manual transmission with the wheel on the right.  It was an adjustment from the US but I felt that it helped me remember to stay on the left side of the road.

New Haven apizza is #1.   

Oh, and Sally’s is planning to open a satellite location in Boca Raton!
Ok.  Can you drive a cybertruck (or any vehicle) in the UK if the wheel is on the left?
Glad she is OK.  What a reckless driver in that Lincoln!
